title: Trigger model: D-Bus methods plus automatic display on player change
context: Upstream shows the media flyout from a global low-level keyboard hook. Wayland forbids that for ordinary clients, and the XDG GlobalShortcuts portal is not available on the target session.
options: xdg-desktop-portal GlobalShortcuts (GNOME 48+, portal absent in the verified environment)
D-Bus methods that a desktop custom shortcut can call
Automatic display whenever the active player changes track or state
proposal: Expose ShowMediaFlyout and friends over D-Bus, and additionally raise the flyout when the active player changes track or playback state (setting show_on_media_change, default on).
decision: D-Bus methods plus show_on_media_change. The portal path remains a documented future option; no Shell extension is shipped.
consequences: Users bind a key once in Settings > Keyboard > Custom Shortcuts.
The flyout can also appear without any key press, which is a deliberate behavioural difference from Windows.
show_on_media_change can be disabled in settings.
